title: unified-rollouts: add progressive canary + shadow A/B rollout controller with multi-metric auto-rollback
author: Ava Chen
description:
Context: Customers asked for a single declarative rollout primitive that supports progressive canaries, A/B experiments, and shadow traffic while giving SREs a reliable automated rollback mechanism driven by multiple metrics (latency P95, request error rate, model quality regressions). Motivation: current rollouts are fragmented across two controllers (canary-controller and ab-controller) which duplicates logic and makes coordinated rollbacks brittle. This PR introduces a unified rollout controller and policy engine that supports: progressive canary ramps, weighted A/B routing, shadow traffic for offline evaluation, and multi-metric auto-rollback with hysteresis.

What this change does: adds a new controller (rollout-controller) that centralizes rollout state and lifecycle, plus a policy DSL for auto-rollback. Key behaviors implemented: 1) progressive canary schedule by percent/time windows (e.g. 1%, 5%, 25%, 100%), 2) shadow traffic mode (copy 100% of production traffic to a non-invasive path for offline eval), 3) A/B routing weight adjustment with traffic steering and metrics-backed promotion, 4) auto-rollback triggers expressed as multi-metric rules (e.g. P95 latency increase > +120ms OR error rate > 0.5% OR quality delta > -3%) with a required sustained window and configurable retry/backoff, 5) safe fallback to previous pinned model version with optional warmup path, 6) integration with autoscaler and KV cache invalidation on variant switch.

Config: rollout CRD (api/v1) extended with `strategy.progressive`, `strategy.abWeights`, `shadow.enabled`, and `policy.autoRollback` where thresholds, windows, and required metrics are declared. The controller exposes rollout events and tracing spans for Console and the Optimize telemetry.

Testing and rollout plan: unit + integration tests added (e2e scenarios: canary->promote, canary->rollback, AB weighted experiment, shadow-only evaluation). Staged rollout to canary cluster for 2 weeks before main. Feature gate `UnifiedRollouts` added; default off and gradually enabled for Dedicated customers.

Checklist:
- [x] Design doc (Linear ENG-9423) linked
- [x] CRD schema and serialization tests
- [x] Controller logic and unit tests
- [x] Integration/e2e tests for rollback paths
- [x] Telemetry events and Console hooks
- [x] Docs and examples updated

Notes: this PR intentionally keeps model evaluation hooks pluggable (we call a registered evaluation-service when quality metrics are configured). We debated including an in-controller evaluator but decided to keep evaluation asynchronous so rollouts remain strictly control-plane focused.

Related: builds on previous rollouts work (see pr-40124 and pr-38921).

review_comments: Marcus Lee (review): overall design looks good. Question: how do we ensure cache warmup won't spike latency during promotion? Suggest adding a warmup path that routes low volume traffic to the promoted variant before full promotion.
Ava Chen (author): added warmup step to strategy.go and documented the low-volume warmup with default 5% for 2 minutes. See new field strategy.warmupPercent and strategy.warmupWindow.

Priya Shah (review): auto-rollback thresholds seem aggressive for some customers; can we make thresholds cluster-scoped defaults and allow overrides per rollout? Also request clearer metrics provenance (what metrics service/reporting).

Ava Chen (author): made thresholds configurable via policy.autoRollback and added docs linking to metrics/collector. Cluster defaults live in config/defaults.yaml and can be overridden per rollout CR.
Evan Martinez (sre): integration tests flaky in CI e2e job (timing-related). I see a race in reconciliation when autoscaler scales pods to zero. We should gate promotion on Ready pod count > 0.
Ava Chen (author): added readiness gating and a retry backoff; re-ran e2e and updated tests to mock scaling behavior.
Marcus Lee (approve): LGTM after responses and tests passing. Approving for merge.
merge_outcome: merged via squash (merge commit: 7a3d4f1). Rollout-controller image bumped to redwood/rollout-controller:v1.3.0. Feature gate UnifiedRollouts remains behind default-off flag.
release_notes: Add unified rollout controller: supports progressive canaries, A/B weighted experiments, shadow traffic, and configurable multi-metric auto-rollback. Default feature gate off. See docs/rollouts.md for configuration and examples.
